text_block_list.text:
Training was off today due to Gold City's 
work commitments. As I headed to the park 
to unwind—

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, isn't that Gold City?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
No way, is that the real deal?! Whoa, her 
face is so tiny! A true masterpiece of the 
gods. What does she even eat? Mist?

Beyond the excited girls stood Gold City, 
surrounded by staff during a photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she looked over here!! Ahh, she's so 
pretty~!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's getting pretty big... 
City-chan, can you keep going like this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I'm used to it. More 
importantly...

"I feel like I just made eye contact with 
Gold City... Surely it's just my 
imagination, though."
choice_data_list:
Assume it's a misunderstanding and quietly 
leave

I'll cheer you on with everything I've 
got!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No. I just thought I saw someone I knew. 
They're already gone, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, next time, I'll keep their eyes 
glued to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait. Hold on. What is she trying to 
do...?"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Looks like there are some pretty 
passionate fans, too~. And they seem super 
devoted, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it. That's just an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No matter who it is, she's the type of 
die-hard good samaritan who'll always try 
to give them a push forward.
